Alice Ramos: :rotating_light: Paging on-call — SolsticeCorp (enterprise VPC) reporting missing traces and metric partitions during p95 latency spike. Customers seeing partial spans in their traces and no access to per-tenant logs.
Ben Cho: Oncall here. Investigating. Are traces completely absent or just missing child spans?
Solstice Support: We're seeing root spans for requests but the downstream service spans (llm-serving runtime) are missing. No logs from the dedicated pool for the affected tenant in the log-forwarder UI.
Claire Ng: Thinking — log forwarder (vpc-forwarder) has a tenant whitelist. Could be a stale routing key after the Dedicated pool scale. Checking routing table now.
DevOps Bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-324. Severity: P2. Pager noticed elevated error rate for tenant=solstice. Participants auto-added: Eng-SRE, Eng-Runtime, Customer Success.
IncidentBot: @oncall please acknowledge within 5m. Links: https://observability.internal/incidents/INC-2026-324
Ben Cho: Acknowledged. Initial hypothesis: routing policy changed during autoscale and Solstice's forwarder token rotated; forwarder failing to authenticate => logs dropped. Traces might still be sampled but not linked.
Evan Patel: I see 401s from the forwarder in the forwarder-proxy logs starting 2026-05-03T14:02:10Z. Sample: "error":"invalid-token","tenant":"solstice","code":401.
Claire Ng: Confirmed. There's a batch of token rotate events in the control plane at 14:02. The per-tenant config was updated but the dedicated pool agent didn't pick up the new token for solstice-dedicated-3.
Solstice Support: This is customer-impacting — they can't debug requests. Legal/ops on the call want ETA for access restoration.
Alice Ramos: Short-term ask: can we grant Solstice read-only access to central logs while we fix VPC forwarder? That plus a trace reindex should restore their observability.
Ben Cho: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Re-deploy forwarder agent with the new token to solstice-dedicated-3. 2) Temporarily mirror logs to central-obsv with tenant tag `tenant=solstice-temp`. 3) Run trace-linker to re-associate spans.
Evan Patel: I can push the redeploy. Command: ```kubectl -n solstice-forwarder set env daemonset/forwarder TOKEN=sha256:abc123 --record``` Will do in 2m.
Claire Ng: I'll create a temporary mirror-rule on the router: ```curl -XPOST https://controlplane/routers/mirror -d '{"src":"solstice-dedicated-3","dest":"central-obsv","tag":"tenant=solstice-temp","ttl":3600}'```
DevOps Bot: Redeploy job queued: job/forwarder-redeploy-1765809123 started by Evan Patel.
Evan Patel: Redeploy complete. Forwarder logs now showing successful handshake: "status":"ok","tenant":"solstice" at 14:08:43Z.
Solstice Support: We can now see logs coming in, but traces still missing for requests between 14:02 and 14:07.
Claire Ng: Trace-linker job needs the KV mapping for the ephemeral IDs; starting reindex with window 14:00-14:15. Command: ```python tools/trace_linker.py --tenant solstice --start 2026-05-03T14:00:00Z --end 2026-05-03T14:15:00Z --out repairs/solstice-1400-1415.ndjson``` This will take ~6-8m.
Ben Cho: Noted. Also adding temporary sampling bump to 100% for solstice to catch any stray traces for the next hour: ```POST /api/v1/sampling/solstice {"rate":1.0}```
Alice Ramos: CS will notify the customer: temporary log access granted and we're re-linking historical traces. ETA ~15 minutes for full readout. @Solstice Support please escalate to customer on the call.
Solstice Support: On it. They asked for assurance this won't recur. Any longer-term mitigations?
Claire Ng: Root cause: control plane token rotation didn't propagate to dedicated pool agent due to a bug in config delta handling when pools scale. Long-term fix: make token rotation resilient by validating token delivery and fallback to cached token; add alert for per-tenant forwarder auth failures crossing threshold.
Evan Patel: I'll open a PR to add a verification handshake post-rotation and a backoff-resync routine. Work items: #1 deploy handshake check, #2 alerting rule (forwarder_auth_error_rate > 0.05 for 5m), #3 postmortem doc.
Ben Cho: For the immediate postmortem: collect timestamps, control plane events, forwarder logs, and the redeploy command. Assigning actions: Evan -> PR + deploy, Claire -> mirror rule and trace-linker run results, Alice -> customer comms & postmortem draft, Ben -> incident timeline & severity review.
DevOps Bot: Action items created: ACTION-1765809123-1 (Evan), ACTION-1765809123-2 (Claire), ACTION-1765809123-3 (Alice), ACTION-1765809123-4 (Ben).
Solstice Support: Customer acknowledges receipt. Thanks for the quick remediation. They asked for a timeline on the permanent mitigation.
Alice Ramos: We'll aim to ship the handshake + alerting in the next sprint (2 weeks) and provide a dedicated rollback / emergency token rotation runbook in 3 business days.
Ben Cho: Closing loop: trace-linker finished, re-linked ~8.2k spans, Solstice traces now backfilled up to p99. Confirmed with customer.
Solstice Support: Verified. They can see full traces again. Marking as resolved on their side.
Alice Ramos: Marking incident resolved here. Please add logs and timeline to the postmortem doc: `docs/incidents/INC-2026-324-postmortem.md` and include mitigation tickets.
Claire Ng: Adding technical notes: root cause snippet: `if delta_tokens and scale_event: skip_apply()` in control plane config sync. Will include patch in PR.
Evan Patel: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/forwarder/merge_requests/1423
Ben Cho: Great work team. After-action: add a test that simulates token rotates during scale. :thumbsup:
DevOps Bot: Incident INC-2026-324 transitioned to RESOLVED. Metrics spike cleared. Follow-ups scheduled.
